patch_resolves_note: The authoritative `-fix` image rejects the stock 13-byte witness before `BinaryReaderObjdump::EndInitExpr()` runs, because `ReadInitExpr()` now requires `final_opcode == Opcode::End`. The closest structural completion `append_end_marker_and_zero_elem_count` reaches the protected finalize event with `final_opcode_code == 11`, so it serves as the genuine fixed-side witness for the missing end-marker obligation even though both versions still read the same uninitialized `current_init_expr_.type` slot when the lone opcode remains `f32.sqrt`.

root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before `ReadInitExpr()` returns success for an element-segment init expression, the last opcode accepted by `ReadInstructions(/*stop_on_end=*/true, read_end_, &final_opcode)` must be `Opcode::End`; plain section end is not a valid init-expression terminator.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable original discards `final_opcode` and therefore accepts the truncated one-byte init expression as successful completion. The fixed program records `final_opcode` and rejects the original witness because it ends at section boundary after `f32.sqrt` instead of after an `END` opcode.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: The vulnerable original records `final_opcode_code=145` and still executes `elem_init_expr_finalize`, so the required predicate is violated on the protected path. The fixed original records the same opcode code but never executes `elem_init_expr_finalize`, so the required assertion is guarded there. The closest source-grounded case `append_end_marker_and_zero_elem_count` records `final_opcode_code=end_opcode_code=11` and does execute `elem_init_expr_finalize` on the fixed image, making the required assertion a genuine witness case.

nodes.state: `BeginInitExpr()` clears only `current_init_expr_.insts`; the same `current_init_expr_.type` stack slot remains live for the later sink path.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records the same `type_slot_ptr` at `elem_init_expr_begin_state` and at `init_expr_type_switch`.

nodes.state: The sole init-expression instruction recorded before finalization is the non-`END` opcode `f32.sqrt`, so none of the `OnI32ConstExpr`/`OnI64ConstExpr`/`OnF32ConstExpr`/`OnF64ConstExpr` type-setting callbacks run on this path.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `init_expr_opcode_record.opcode_code == init_expr_type_switch.opcode_code == 145`.

nodes.state: Inside the `expr.insts.size() == 1` branch, `InitExprToConstOffset()` switches on `expr.type`, producing the MemorySanitizer-reported uninitialized read.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace reaches `init_expr_type_switch` with the same `type_slot_ptr` captured at `elem_init_expr_begin_state`.

edges.relation: The `current_init_expr_.type` slot preserved when the element init expression begins is forwarded unchanged into `InitExprToConstOffset()` and read there as `expr.type`.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `elem_init_expr_begin_state.type_slot_ptr == init_expr_type_switch.type_slot_ptr`.

edges.relation: The same sole init-expression opcode recorded in `current_init_expr_.insts` is the opcode carried into the one-instruction sink branch at `InitExprToConstOffset()`.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `init_expr_opcode_record.opcode_code == init_expr_type_switch.opcode_code == 145`.
